lore_anchors.definition: A basic perception spell that reveals magical power; also a primitive form of soul confusion if the user has a vastly higher cultivation level than the target.
A demonic sect formation that traps and kills cultivators while preserving their souls and primordial spirits for evil arts.
The elite enforcers of the Ghost Spirit Sect, tasked with hunting and killing any survivors or witnesses to the sect's ambush.
A compulsory military draft issued by the Seven Great Sects to all clans in the Yue Kingdom, punishable by extermination if disobeyed.
One of the Six Demonic Sects of the Tianluo Nation, specializing in commanding ghosts, demons, poison arts, and shadow techniques.
